{{Short description|Psychiatric scale}}
The '''Minnesota Borderline Personality Disorder Scale''' ('''MBPD''') is a measure of [[borderline personality disorder]] traits. The scale was created in 2011 by and uses items from the [[Multidimensional Personality Questionnaire]], an instrument commonly included in large [[Longitudinal study | longitudinal]] [[Data set | data sets]], so that such past studies can be reanalyzed to study borderline personality disorder.<ref>Bornovalova, Marina A., et al. [https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3094502/ "Development and validation of the Minnesota Borderline Personality Disorder scale."] Assessment 18.2 (2011): 234-252.</ref><ref>Rojas, Elizabeth, [http://scholarcommons.usf.edu/etd/4837 "Longitudinal Validation and Diagnostic Accuracy of the Minnesota Borderline Personality Disorder Scale (MBPD)".] (2013). Graduate School Theses and Dissertations.</ref>
